description: AICTIONBOT™ price increase check by KULIC Advisory. Compares a supplier's requested price increase with the official Eurostat producer price index (goods) or services producer price index plus labour cost index (services) for Germany since the last price agreement. Returns market change, gap in percentage points, a verdict (in line, slightly above, clearly above, market fell), an evidence-based counter-offer level and the source. Deterministic, no AI, no personal data. Not legal advice. Use list_categories to pick a category code.

annual_volume_eur.description: Optional annual spend with this supplier in EUR, to express the gap in euros.

category.description: Category code from list_categories (e.g. C17 for paper and packaging, N81 for cleaning) or its German or English name.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

last_agreement.description: Month of the last agreed price, YYYY-MM (2019-01 or later).

requested_increase_percent.description: Increase the supplier requests, in percent (e.g. 9.5).

name: check_price_increase
title: Check a supplier price increase against official market data (Germany)
